statusDetail: Coverage-complete report-mode audit of four representative anonymous surfaces. Excluded authenticated feed creation/upload, checkout/commerce, live-stream interaction and account settings because they require credentials or materially distinct privileged state.

page.notes: Public short-video feed with Explore, login and PWA shell. The page is heavily client-rendered.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Screenshot comparison under dark preference shows the shell remains a coherent dark design.
The reduced-motion evaluate probe found six ~531ms document animations, including running animations, while matchMedia(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) was true.
High-contrast emulation screenshot retains visible feed, controls and text.
The rendered DOM probe found no startViewTransition usage; navigation between feed and Explore swaps state without a documented transition treatment.
No authored parallax, reveal or other scroll-linked animation was present on the representative surfaces; native feed scrolling was tested instead.
checkOutcomes.reason: No authored parallax, reveal or other scroll-linked animation was present on the representative surfaces; native feed scrolling was tested instead.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Feed and Explore use native vertical scrolling and the sampled media is not autoplaying at probe time.
Persistent side navigation identifies For You/Explore and stays available while feed content scrolls.
Opening More produced a DIV role=dialog at x=220/y=84 and the stylesheet probe found zero anchor-name, position-anchor or position-try rules.
Explore selection, content-first feed paging and labeled navigation controls provide clear current-state cues.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct review using evidence/home-desktop.png, evidence/explore-desktop.png, evidence/login-desktop.png
checkOutcomes.evidence: Desktop, Explore, login and 404 screenshots show a 200px cookie panel covering roughly the lower 40% of the 493px viewport before interaction.
The initial DOM contained no dialog, popover or details elements; the More menu opened as a DIV role=dialog and the cookie banner is a custom shadow-DOM element.
After consent dismissal the feed dedicates most of the viewport to the current video, with compact side actions.
At a 360px visual viewport, the layout primitive measured 492px content width and 132px horizontal overflow. The screenshot visibly clips the video and caption.
The CSSOM probe found zero @container rules while the same shell presents feed cards and a three-column Explore grid in different available widths.
The focus probe reported outline-style none and no box-shadow for every sampled control; navigation buttons are 40x40px and several links are only 16-23px high.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence review: evidence/home-dark.png, evidence/explore-desktop.png, evidence/login-desktop.png
checkOutcomes.evidence: For You immediately presents a video feed; Explore presents topical cards; login clearly labels its purpose and methods.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence review: evidence/home-after-consent-probe.json, evidence/explore-desktop.png, evidence/login-probe.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: Anonymous users can consume the feed, navigate to Explore and open login choices without a forced account wall.
The unknown-route test renders a branded 404 state with global search/login navigation instead of a blank shell.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct review using evidence/lighthouse.json, evidence/home-trace-summary.json, evidence/home-trace.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 22.3s, FCP 12.0s, TBT 1,394ms and performance 0.30; the independent trace measured LCP 4.64s and TBT 2.55s.
The mobile layout observer measured CLS 0.0186, within the good threshold despite later shifts.
The trace found nine long tasks, including one 2,410ms task, for 2,555ms total blocking time; Lighthouse TBT was 1,394ms.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct review using evidence/home-summary.json, evidence/resource-dom-probe.json, evidence/home.har
checkOutcomes.evidence: The HAR recorded 362 requests and 8.83MB transferred; 214 scripts account for 6.31MB, with parser-inserted non-deferred scripts confirmed in the DOM probe.
The HAR recorded 214 scripts and 6.31MB script transfer, including multiple monitoring plugin versions and login chunks on the unauthenticated feed.
Lighthouse found unnamed buttons and links, unlabeled password inputs and images without alt; the agent accessibility tree audit also failed.
Lighthouse found 3.0:1 white-on-cyan cookie text and 3.68:1 white-on-pink Open TikTok text, below the required 4.5:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct review using evidence/home-after-consent-probe.json, evidence/lighthouse-failures.json, evidence/focus-targets.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage has no H1, Lighthouse found skipped heading order, and the focus probe showed outline-style none on all sampled keyboard targets.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence review: evidence/home-dark.png, evidence/explore-desktop.png, evidence/login-desktop.png
checkOutcomes.evidence: Screenshots show readable feed captions, topic labels and login choices with adequate line lengths; contrast exceptions are separately recorded.
The 360px layout has 132px horizontal overflow; sampled navigation targets are 40x40px and text links as little as 16px high.
Lighthouse failed errors-in-console, including a 400 API request and repeated CSP policy warnings.
The images primitive found all four sampled images missing width and height attributes, two oversized avatars and two legacy-format resources.
Lighthouse found unload listeners, deprecated Shared Storage use, and six BFCache blockers including unload, no-store and WebSocket conditions.
The rendered metadata probe found a title but no meta description; discoverability confirmed the description is absent in raw HTML.
Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors for a Learn more anchor without href and link-name for an unlabeled search link.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct review using evidence/lighthouse-failures.json, evidence/robots.txt, evidence/sitemap.xml
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found no valid rel=canonical; /sitemap.xml returned Not Found, while robots.txt defines a selective crawl policy.
The DOM probe found zero JSON-LD blocks and no Open Graph metadata on the public homepage.
Headers show HTTPS/HSTS but CSP allows unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval; the cookie audit found nine cookies flagged insecure and msToken without Secure/HttpOnly using SameSite=None.
The tracker probe found 16 third-party origins; the HAR attributed 329 requests and 8.59MB to third-party origins, including monitoring domains, before account interaction.
The login probe offers QR, phone/email/username, Facebook, Google and Apple; neither rendered markup nor the DOM contained passkey/WebAuthn signals.
Permissions-Policy is missing and CSP permits unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval; Lighthouse also reported third-party cookie and CSP inspector issues.
Discoverability measured only 3% raw/rendered word coverage and classified the page as a JS shell; the crawler screenshot is effectively blank while the browser screenshot contains the feed.
The More menu opened within the viewport and the feed remained usable after repeated scrolling.
A scoped active service worker and installable manifest with name, icons, start_url and display mode were directly observed.
A deliberately unknown route produced a branded 404 recovery surface with search and login navigation.
Rendered documents declare en/en-GB and ltr, and login exposes a broad language selector including RTL languages.
The session rendered en-GB locale selection and region-aware content; no malformed locale-sensitive numeric/date formatting was observed.
No event, timestamp editing or other time-zone-sensitive value appeared on the audited anonymous surfaces.
checkOutcomes.reason: No event, timestamp editing or other time-zone-sensitive value appeared on the audited anonymous surfaces.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Consent presents equally prominent Decline optional cookies and Allow all controls; login terms and privacy links are visible.
The audited unauthenticated login entry rendered method-choice and federated controls but no editable authored form on which validation behavior could be exercised.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited unauthenticated login entry rendered method-choice and federated controls but no editable authored form on which validation behavior could be exercised.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found four password inputs without labels; the markup snippets expose no autocomplete token, placeholder or accessible name.
The public login entry offers QR, phone/email/username and federated providers but no passkey or WebAuthn path.
Two of four sampled images are oversized, all lack width/height and two use legacy formats; one below-fold image lacks lazy loading.
The initial load makes 362 requests including 89 fetch/XHR requests and multiple monitoring endpoints; trace TBT is 2.55s.
Third parties account for 329 requests and 8.59MB of 8.83MB transferred; scripts alone are 6.31MB and fonts 643KB.
Agent-facing capabilities are emerging and no developer intent to expose TikTok actions to agents was declared; absence is not penalised.
checkOutcomes.reason: Agent-facing capabilities are emerging and no developer intent to expose TikTok actions to agents was declared; absence is not penalised.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation or language-model task was part of the audited anonymous journeys, so on-device inference is not applicable.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation or language-model task was part of the audited anonymous journeys, so on-device inference is not applicable.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten feed scroll-down/up cycles, heap self size changed from 100.06MB to 100.87MB while node count fell from 1,765,634 to 1,753,945; no monotonic retained growth is established.
The baseline heap summary contains 1,765,634 nodes/records and 100.1MB self size, including 492,545 code entries and 164,467 closures for one visible feed card.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence review: evidence/memory-metrics.json, evidence/heap-baseline.heapsnapshot, evidence/heap-post.heapsnapshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: After repeated scrolling, live DOM nodes fell from 764 to 706 and heap node count fell; Detached constructors did not appear among the largest baseline/post constructors.

principleOutcomes.reason: All checks were judged contextual and not applicable to the audited anonymous journeys.

paths.description: Public For You feed, the primary content-consumption journey and global shell.
Explore listing, representing discovery/category browsing and card-grid layout.
Authentication entry point, representing account, consent, localization and sign-in choices.
Unknown route, representing HTTP/runtime failure recovery.

findings.summary: Motion continues when reduced motion is requested
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion evaluate probe found six ~531ms document animations, including running animations, while matchMedia(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) was true.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential animation and autoplay transitions inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; retain only essential state feedback.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: The rendered DOM probe found no startViewTransition usage; navigation between feed and Explore swaps state without a documented transition treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance meaningful same-document route/state changes with document.startViewTransition(), with a non-animated fallback and reduced-motion override.

findings.summary: The More overlay is manually positioned rather than anchored
findings.evidence: Opening More produced a DIV role=dialog at x=220/y=84 and the stylesheet probe found zero anchor-name, position-anchor or position-try rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover plus CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks so the menu remains attached and collision-safe.

findings.summary: Cookie consent obscures a large share of every first view
findings.evidence: Desktop, Explore, login and 404 screenshots show a 200px cookie panel covering roughly the lower 40% of the 493px viewport before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, accessible consent surface that preserves an equally prominent decline choice without hiding primary content; remember the decision.

findings.summary: Overlays use custom elements and ad-hoc dialog roles
findings.evidence: The initial DOM contained no dialog, popover or details elements; the More menu opened as a DIV role=dialog and the cookie banner is a custom shadow-DOM element.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native dialog for modal consent and popover for transient menus, with declarative invocation and light-dismiss where appropriate.

findings.summary: The mobile layout overflows horizontally
findings.evidence: At a 360px visual viewport, the layout primitive measured 492px content width and 132px horizontal overflow. The screenshot visibly clips the video and caption.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed/minimum widths that force 492px layout; use intrinsic sizing, max-inline-size:100%, and test the consent/feed shell at 320-360px.

findings.summary: Reusable feed and listing components show no container-query adaptation
findings.evidence: The CSSOM probe found zero @container rules while the same shell presents feed cards and a three-column Explore grid in different available widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container-type and size-aware component rules where cards/shell modules are reused, retaining media-query fallbacks only where needed.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated and several controls are undersized
findings.evidence: The focus probe reported outline-style none and no box-shadow for every sampled control; navigation buttons are 40x40px and several links are only 16-23px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible styles and enlarge interactive hit areas to at least 44x44 CSS px without relying on hover.

findings.summary: Loading performance is far outside the good range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 22.3s, FCP 12.0s, TBT 1,394ms and performance 0.30; the independent trace measured LCP 4.64s and TBT 2.55s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP media/poster, reduce startup JavaScript, defer non-critical monitoring/login code, and validate under representative mobile throttling.

findings.summary: Startup JavaScript blocks the main thread
findings.evidence: The trace found nine long tasks, including one 2,410ms task, for 2,555ms total blocking time; Lighthouse TBT was 1,394ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Break startup work into schedulable tasks, defer islands until needed and remove forced synchronous layout from monitoring code.

findings.summary: The dependency graph is extremely large and delays content
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 362 requests and 8.83MB transferred; 214 scripts account for 6.31MB, with parser-inserted non-deferred scripts confirmed in the DOM probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Ship only critical bootstrap code, mark non-critical scripts async/defer, reduce fonts, and audit cache/dependency chains.

findings.summary: Script volume dominates the page before user intent
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 214 scripts and 6.31MB script transfer, including multiple monitoring plugin versions and login chunks on the unauthenticated feed.
findings.suggestedFix: Use coverage/bundle analysis to remove duplicate monitoring versions and gate login, analytics and secondary feature bundles behind intent.

findings.summary: Controls, links, images and inputs lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found unnamed buttons and links, unlabeled password inputs and images without alt; the agent accessibility tree audit also failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every interactive control a stable accessible name, associate labels with inputs, and provide meaningful or empty alt text as appropriate.

findings.summary: Text and primary controls fail WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 3.0:1 white-on-cyan cookie text and 3.68:1 white-on-pink Open TikTok text, below the required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet 4.5:1 for normal text and verify all consent/control states.

findings.summary: Heading structure and focus presentation are not robust
findings.evidence: The homepage has no H1, Lighthouse found skipped heading order, and the focus probe showed outline-style none on all sampled keyboard targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a logical H1-to-Hn hierarchy, proper landmarks, and a clearly visible focus indicator following reading order.

findings.summary: Reflow and target sizing fail on narrow screens
findings.evidence: The 360px layout has 132px horizontal overflow; sampled navigation targets are 40x40px and text links as little as 16px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the shell reflow without overflow and expand pointer/touch hit areas while preserving zoom and scalable viewport behavior.

findings.summary: The page emits runtime and network console errors
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed errors-in-console, including a 400 API request and repeated CSP policy warnings.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix or intentionally suppress failed startup requests and deliver an enforceable, internally consistent CSP without browser warnings.

findings.summary: Image markup does not reserve stable dimensions
findings.evidence: The images primitive found all four sampled images missing width and height attributes, two oversized avatars and two legacy-format resources.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio, responsive srcset/sizes and modern formats for authored imagery.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and BFCache blockers remain
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found unload listeners, deprecated Shared Storage use, and six BFCache blockers including unload, no-store and WebSocket conditions.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unload handlers and deprecated Shared Storage calls; minimize actionable no-store mutations so return navigation can use BFCache.

findings.summary: The public homepage has no meta description
findings.evidence: The rendered metadata probe found a title but no meta description; discoverability confirmed the description is absent in raw HTML.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise, page-specific meta description to raw server HTML.

findings.summary: Some links are unnamed or not crawlable
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors for a Learn more anchor without href and link-name for an unlabeled search link.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real destination href values and descriptive accessible link text for all navigation and disclosure links.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals are incomplete
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found no valid rel=canonical; /sitemap.xml returned Not Found, while robots.txt defines a selective crawl policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit canonical URLs per public template and publish sitemap indexes consistent with robots and localized routes.

findings.summary: The homepage lacks entity and share-preview metadata
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found zero JSON-LD blocks and no Open Graph metadata on the public homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite and page/entity JSON-LD plus Open Graph/Twitter preview metadata matching visible content.

findings.summary: Cookie and CSP posture has avoidable weaknesses
findings.evidence: Headers show HTTPS/HSTS but CSP allows unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval; the cookie audit found nine cookies flagged insecure and msToken without Secure/HttpOnly using SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Move to nonce/hash-based CSP without unsafe-eval, set Secure and HttpOnly on sensitive tokens, and use Lax/Strict unless cross-site behavior is required.

findings.summary: The initial anonymous load has a very large telemetry and third-party footprint
findings.evidence: The tracker probe found 16 third-party origins; the HAR attributed 329 requests and 8.59MB to third-party origins, including monitoring domains, before account interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate optional telemetry behind consent, consolidate monitoring, batch events and load only third parties required for the immediate task.

findings.summary: The login entry exposes no phishing-resistant passkey option
findings.evidence: The login probe offers QR, phone/email/username, Facebook, Google and Apple; neither rendered markup nor the DOM contained passkey/WebAuthn signals.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey authentication and registration alongside existing methods, using conditional UI where supported.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policy coverage is incomplete
findings.evidence: Permissions-Policy is missing and CSP permits unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval; Lighthouse also reported third-party cookie and CSP inspector issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a least-privilege Permissions-Policy, tighten CSP/Trusted Types where applicable, and complete third-party-cookie migration.

findings.summary: Core feed content is unavailable without JavaScript
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 3% raw/rendered word coverage and classified the page as a JS shell; the crawler screenshot is effectively blank while the browser screenshot contains the feed.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render meaningful feed/discovery content and crawlable links, then hydrate enhancements progressively.

findings.summary: Hidden sign-in inputs lack basic input semantics
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found four password inputs without labels; the markup snippets expose no autocomplete token, placeholder or accessible name.
findings.suggestedFix: Label each sign-in field and provide correct username/current-password/one-time-code autocomplete tokens.

findings.summary: Account access relies on legacy/federated choices without passkey management
findings.evidence: The public login entry offers QR, phone/email/username and federated providers but no passkey or WebAuthn path.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey sign-in, registration and management with clear recovery and reauthentication behavior.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes and omits intrinsic metadata
findings.evidence: Two of four sampled images are oversized, all lack width/height and two use legacy formats; one below-fold image lacks lazy loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve right-sized AVIF/WebP sources with srcset/sizes, dimensions and lazy loading below the fold.

findings.summary: Anonymous startup performs excessive background work
findings.evidence: The initial load makes 362 requests including 89 fetch/XHR requests and multiple monitoring endpoints; trace TBT is 2.55s.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer, batch or remove background telemetry and secondary fetches until idle, visibility or explicit user intent.

findings.summary: Third-party code dominates the resource budget
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 329 requests and 8.59MB of 8.83MB transferred; scripts alone are 6.31MB and fonts 643KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set per-route third-party/script/font budgets, gate login/media extras and monitor regressions in CI.

findings.summary: The initial heap footprint is disproportionate to the visible feed
findings.evidence: The baseline heap summary contains 1,765,634 nodes/records and 100.1MB self size, including 492,545 code entries and 164,467 closures for one visible feed card.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce loaded bundles and long-lived closures, virtualize aggressively and set heap/DOM budgets for the unauthenticated shell.

taskList.title: Cut startup JavaScript, request count and long main-thread tasks
Fix mobile reflow, focus visibility and target sizing
Repair names, labels, alt text, headings and contrast
Server-render public content and complete metadata/indexing signals
Reduce telemetry and harden cookies, CSP and browser policies
Replace intrusive/custom overlays with native dialog and popover patterns
Add reduced-motion handling and progressive route transitions
Add passkey-based sign-in and account management
Optimize responsive images and reserve dimensions
Remove console errors, deprecated APIs and actionable BFCache blockers
Introduce container-aware component layouts where modules are reused
